programme.title: My Gal Sunday
programme.desc: Henry, the recently retired U.S. Secretary of State, and his wife, Sunday, are private investigators. When Sunday's parents are kidnapped, the two work together to rescue them and find out why the abductors want a hit-man released as ransom.

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular.

programme.title: Breakaway
programme.desc: A young man is torn between his traditional Indo-Canadian family expectations and his dreams of playing hockey.

programme.title: Bang the Drum Slowly
programme.desc: When hotshot pitcher Henry Wiggen (Michael Moriarty) is signed to the New York Mammoths, his confident ways quickly win over his teammates. He's quite the opposite of Bruce Pearson (Robert De Niro), the team's simpleminded catcher, who has difficulty connecting with others. But when Henry discovers that Bruce has been hiding that he was recently diagnosed with a fatal form of cancer, the unlikely pair become close. Despite Henry's efforts to look out for Bruce, however, team tensions rise.

programme.title: Some Kind of Hero
programme.desc: A Vietnam POW (Richard Pryor) comes home after six years to no wife, no business and no chance of getting back pay.

programme.title: Bang the Drum Slowly
programme.desc: When hotshot pitcher Henry Wiggen (Michael Moriarty) is signed to the New York Mammoths, his confident ways quickly win over his teammates. He's quite the opposite of Bruce Pearson (Robert De Niro), the team's simpleminded catcher, who has difficulty connecting with others. But when Henry discovers that Bruce has been hiding that he was recently diagnosed with a fatal form of cancer, the unlikely pair become close. Despite Henry's efforts to look out for Bruce, however, team tensions rise.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: A turf battle between New York City street gangs that rages from Coney Island to the Bronx. The Warriors are mistakenly fingered for the killing of a gang leader. Soon they have every gang in the city out to get revenge, and they must make their way across the city to their own turf.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.title: Night Falls on Manhattan
programme.desc: New attorney Sean Casey (Andy Garcia), a former policeman, has been unexpectedly tapped to prosecute a case against drug dealer Jordan Washington (Shiek Mahmud-Bey). Washington's lawyer, Sam Vigoda (Richard Dreyfuss), claims that there is a police cover-up against his client. However, Casey wins the trial and soon becomes county district attorney. It's then that he finds evidence that there may have really been corruption in the force, and it could involve his father, Liam (Ian Holm).

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular.

programme.title: Ordinary People
programme.desc: Tormented by guilt following the death of his older brother, Buck, in a sailing accident, alienated teenager Conrad Jarrett (Timothy Hutton) attempts suicide. Returning home following an extended stay in a psychiatric hospital, Conrad tries to deal with his mental anguish and also reconnect with his mother, Beth (Mary Tyler Moore), who has grown cold and angry, and his emotionally wounded father, Calvin (Donald Sutherland), with the help of his psychiatrist, Dr. Berger (Judd Hirsch).

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Donald "Sully" Sullivan (Paul Newman) is an expert at avoiding adult responsibilities. At 60, he divides all his time between a local bar and the occasional construction job. When his estranged son, Peter (Dylan Walsh), arrives in town, bringing with him a son of his own and a sob story about his failed marriage, Sully finds himself assuming the roles of both father and grandfather. After a life of unchecked self-indulgence, he wonders if he is up to the task.

programme.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programme.desc: While shopping at an outdoor market, young reporter Tintin (Jamie Bell), accompanied by his faithful dog, Snowy, buys a model of an old ship called the Unicorn. A shady character named Sakharine (Daniel Craig) and later an American named Barnaby (Joe Starr) try to buy the model from him, but Tintin refuses. The lad discovers that the ship contains a clue about a hidden treasure, but before he can locate it, Tintin is kidnapped and given over to the custody of drunken Capt. Haddock (Andy Serkis).

programme.title: Night Falls on Manhattan
programme.desc: New attorney Sean Casey (Andy Garcia), a former policeman, has been unexpectedly tapped to prosecute a case against drug dealer Jordan Washington (Shiek Mahmud-Bey). Washington's lawyer, Sam Vigoda (Richard Dreyfuss), claims that there is a police cover-up against his client. However, Casey wins the trial and soon becomes county district attorney. It's then that he finds evidence that there may have really been corruption in the force, and it could involve his father, Liam (Ian Holm).

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

programme.title: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In 1975, a group of five men were driving home after working in a forest when they see a mysterious light. Intrigued, Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) leaves the truck - only to be sucked up by a flying saucer. The other four men report the strange event, but they are skeptically interrogated by Lt. Frank Walters (James Garner), who suspects that murder is behind Walton's disappearance. When Walton reappears five days later, his story of alien abduction is met with disbelief.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: While racing toward the town of Red Rock in post-Civil War Wyoming, bounty hunter John "The Hangman" Ruth (Kurt Russell) and his fugitive prisoner (Jennifer Jason Leigh) encounter another bounty hunter (Samuel L. Jackson) and a man who claims to be a sheriff. Hoping to find shelter from a blizzard, the group travels to a stagecoach stopover located on a mountain pass. Greeted there by four strangers, the eight travelers soon learn that they may not make it to their destination after all.

programme.title: The Education of Little Tree
programme.desc: During the Great Depression, 8-year-old Native American Little Tree (Joseph Ashton) loses his mother and father. Little Tree is sent to live in the Smokey Mountains with his grandparents (James Cromwell, Tantoo Cardinal), who show the young boy how to live in the wilderness. They introduce him to Willow John (Graham Greene), a medicine man who teaches Little Tree about his Cherokee heritage. But when the local government makes the boy attend a state school, his world is turned upside down.

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Quick Pitch
programme.desc: Sometimes, fans of America's national pastime might miss a day or two of their favorite sport due to pesky things like work, a wedding anniversary, or a child's high-school graduation ceremony. Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups.

programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown."

programme.title: Самый страшный дом в Америке, 3 сезон, 1 эп. The Wretched Road Trip Begins.
Dorota was urządzi
programme.desc: Wyobraźnia Doroty Szelągowskiej nie zna granic. Projektantka wnętrz potrafi zdziałać cuda nawet w najmniejszej przestrzeni, na którą właścicielom brakuje już pomysłów. Każda "demolka" w wykonaniu ekipy remontowej kończy się spektakularnym sukcesem. Prowadząca ma także niezwykły dar robienia fantastycznych rzeczy praktycznie z niczego. Stare meble czy nieużywane bibeloty zawsze znajdą nowe zastosowanie. W nowym sezonie na Dorotę Szelągowską czekają kolejne wyzwania, m.in. urządzenie pokoju dla dwóch nastolatek o całkowicie różnych temperamentach. Prowadząca dostanie także zlecenia specjalne: prezent ślubny dla narzeczonych i niezwykłą niespodziankę na osiemnastkę Kuba, pasjonat przebierania się za postaci z mangi, gier komputerowych i filmów, jest szczęśliwym partnerem Doroty, która wspiera go w realizacji pasji. Para wspólnie szyje stroje, przygotowuje eksponaty i bierze udział w tematycznych konwentach. Obecnie najważniejszą imprezą sezonu jest ich ślub. W związku z rozpoczęciem noweg

programme.title: Nowa Maja w ogrodzie
programme.desc: Bad Zwischenahn na północy Niemiec. W tym rejonie słynne jest szkółkarstwo roślin ozdobnych. Warto zobaczyć tam ogrody pokazowe, parki i jedną z największych w kraju kolekcji różaneczników. Urodą nie ustępują im prywatne zielone przestrzenie. Kamera odwiedza Anke i Carstena Wragge, którzy - podobnie jak w przypadku większości miejscowych posesji - nie posiadają furtki. Na działkę wchodzi się bramą utworzoną przez korony drzew o parasolowatej formie. Bohaterowie odcinka są właścicielami eleganckiego ogrodu, otoczonego przystrzyżonymi bukowymi żywopłotami. Na środku części reprezentacyjnej znajduje się trawnik. Pod ścianą domu urządzono taras wypoczynkowy z prostokątnym oczkiem wodnym. Można tu też znaleźć staw sprawiający wrażenie naturalnej sadzawki. Grupa parasolowatych drzew kryje warzywnik oraz szkółkę krzewów ozdobnych. Do niej przylega stajnia dla kucyków. Tradycyjnym budulcem rejonu dla domów czy nawierzchni pozostaje klinkier.

Każda "demolka" w wykonaniu ekipy remontowej kończy się spektakularnym sukcesem. Prowadząca ma także niezwykły dar robienia fantastycznych rzeczy praktycznie z niczego. Stare meble czy nieużywane bibeloty zawsze znajdą nowe zastosowanie. W nowym sezonie na Dorotę Szelągowską czekają kolejne wyzwania, m.in. urządzenie pokoju dla dwóch nastolatek o całkowicie różnych temperamentach. Prowadząca dostanie także zlecenia specjalne: prezent ślubny dla narzeczonych i niezwykłą niespodziankę na osiemnastkę Małgosia i jej syn Olek to wyjątkowo zgrany duet, który zgodnie stwierdził, że ich salon potrzebuje metamorfozy. Kobieta ma dwie pasje: konie i rośliny. Miłością do tych zwierząt zaraziła również syna. W domu jest dużo roślin doniczkowych. programme.desc: W tym odcinku Maja Popielarska odwiedzi ogród w kaszubskiej wsi, który położony jest na dosyć stromej skarpie. Od strony drogi znajduje się tam duży podjazd, a za nim dwa budynki: dom mieszkalny i pracownia. Wokół nich jest układ murków, które niwelują różnice terenu. W części przedogródka są one wykonane z betonu, a od strony ogrodu z drewnianej palisady. Przy budynku zaprojektowano jeszcze oszklony taras i kilka wnętrz ogrodowych ukrytych pomiędzy niskimi sosnami. Na każdym z tarasów rzucają się w oczy kolorowe drewniane meble, na których w trakcie spotkan ustawiane są napoje lub przekąski. Właściciel lubi gotować i często zaprasza licznych znajomych. W domu ma zieloną ścianę obsadzoną filodendronami, anturium, paprociami. Wykonuje również obrazy z suszonych mchów. Kreatywność w tym miejscu sięgnęła zenitu.

Wraz ze swoją niezastąpioną ekipą prowadzący w zaledwie kilka dni i przy niewielkim budżecie sprawi, że ogród w katastrofalnym stanie będzie wymarzonym miejscem, w którym można siedzieć godzinami i zrelaksować się po ciężkim dniu. Rośliny wreszcie będą posadzone tam gdzie trzeba, a każdy z domowników znajdzie w ogrodzie coś dla siebie. Ekipy nie zniechęci żadne wyzwanie, a ich metamorfozy zaskoczą nie tylko widzów.

Marta skończyła studia prawnicze i założyła swoją kancelarię w Warszawie. Do tej pory wynajmowała ciasne mieszkanie, które ostatnio zamieniła na własnym dom na obrzeżach miasta. Jednak nieruchomość ta wymaga generalnego remontu. Właścicielce, mimo usilnych prób, nie udało się skończyć metamorfozy posiadłości. Przyjaciółka Marty postanawia jednak przejąć inicjatywę i zrobić koleżance niespodziankę, zgłaszając ją do programu. Każda "demolka" w wykonaniu ekipy remontowej kończy się spektakularnym sukcesem. Prowadząca ma także niezwykły dar robienia fantastycznych rzeczy praktycznie z niczego. Stare meble czy nieużywane bibeloty zawsze znajdą nowe zastosowanie. W nowym sezonie na Dorotę Szelągowską czekają kolejne wyzwania, m.in. urządzenie pokoju dla dwóch nastolatek o całkowicie różnych temperamentach. Prowadząca dostanie także zlecenia specjalne: prezent ślubny dla narzeczonych i niezwykłą niespodziankę na osiemnastkę Paulina na pierwszym miejscu stawia dobro swoich podopiecznych, często zapominając o sobie i własnych potrzebach. Wyręcza pociechy we wszystkim, co możliwe. Kiedy przeprowadzają się do nowego mieszkania, remont zaczyna właśnie od pokoju Zuzi i Oskara. programme.title: Преображённый квартал, 4 сезон, 9 эп. The Art Deco House.
Dorota inspiruje
programme.desc: Gospodyni programu, Dorota Szelągowska, pokaże jak przy niewielkich nakładach finansowych zamienić źle zaaranżowane, brzydkie i zagracone pomieszczenia w funkcjonalne i ładne przestrzenie. W każdym odcinku projektantka odwiedzi właścicieli mieszkania i przeprowadzi metamorfozę wybranego przez nich pokoju. Udowodni, że aby wnętrza nabrały zupełnie innego charakteru wcale nie potrzeba demolki i burzenia ścian. Najważniejsze są bowiem dobry pomysł, kreatywność, odpowiedni nakład pracy i dobre chęci. Sukces pomoże też osiągnąć wprowadzenie sprytnych usprawnień, mądry wybór materiałów i dodatków, zmiana kolorystyki oraz aranżacji. Dorota Szelągowska podejmie się też renowacji starych sprzętów i stworzy niebanalne dekoracje. Program "Dorota inspiruje" to zbiór praktycznych i łatwych do zastosowania porad związanych ze wszystkimi domowymi powierzchniami Dorotę Szelągowską o pomoc poprosili Kasia i jej dwoje dzieci. Ekipy nie zniechęci żadne wyzwanie, a ich metamorfozy zaskoczą nie tylko widzów Paweł, Ilona, Maks i Anastazja tworzą wesołą rodzinkę, która mieszka w ładnym segmencie na niewielkim osiedlu. Paweł próbuje uporać się z ich 60-metrowym przydomowym ogródkiem już od dziesięciu lat. Do tej pory ułożył patio z kostki oraz postawił nad nim zadaszenie. Reszta przestrzeni przypomina plac budowy. Znajdują się tam stara huśtawka, hałdy ziemi, śmieci, a także zaledwie kilka rosnących pod płot

programme.desc: Remont mieszkania to ogromne wyzwanie. Począwszy od zaplanowania wydatków, przez wyposażenie we wszystko, co niezbędne do metamorfozy, po znalezienie ekipy remontowej. Lista zakupów z czasem zaczyna się bowiem piętrzyć, projekt wnętrza dynamicznie się zmienia, a ogrom pracy przerasta. Krzysztof Miruć, architekt i pasjonat designu, przybywa na pomoc tym, którzy czują potrzebę zmiany swojego mieszkania.To specjalista, który wie, jak nadawać pomieszczeniom drugie życie. Dbałość o detale i funkcjonalność, to jego znaki rozpoznawcze. Podejmie każde remontowe wyzwanie i zamienia w perełkę przestrzeń, która trafi w jego ręce. Wystarczy, że bohaterowie wskażą mu pomieszczenie, które chcą odnowić, podadzą budżet, jakim dysponują i zdradzą o jakiej zmianie marzą. Wyjątkowy efekt gwarantowany, a wszystko zaledwie w ciągu kilku dni.

programme.desc: Magnus (Keir Dullea) and Julia Lofting (Mia Farrow) have a happy marriage until one morning when their daughter Kate (Sophie Ward) begins choking. Unsure what to do, Julia attempts a tracheotomy, inadvertently causing Kate's death. Julia heads to a sanitarium to recover, and when Magnus asks that she come home, she prefers to buy a new house in London and live alone there. Magnus frets over Julia's sanity, while Julia becomes convinced that her house is haunted by the spirit of a little girl.

Accompanied only by the town drunk, Alex Potter (Henry Jones), Dan battles Wade's henchman (Richard Jaeckel), the murder victim's revenge-minded brother, and the temptation of the large bribe Wade offers in exchange for his freedom.

programme.title: Jeremiah Johnson
programme.desc: A Mexican-American War veteran, Jeremiah Johnson (Robert Redford), heads to the mountains to live in isolation. Woefully unequipped for the task at hand, Johnson is fortunate to come across a seasoned mountain man (Will Geer) willing to teach him the necessary survival tactics. As life continues in the mountains, Johnson finds himself a native bride (Delle Bolton) and an adopted son (Josh Albee). However, their peaceful existence is threatened when Johnson incurs the ire of the Crow Indians.

programme.desc: In 1963, with President John F. Kennedy growing more liberal and humanitarian in his policies, a shadowy cabal of Texas oil magnates, hardline conservatives, intelligence agents and rogue operatives meet to discuss possible action. The swaggering Foster (Robert Ryan) wants JFK dead, but the mysterious and powerful Ferguson (Will Geer) rebuffs the idea. Still, Farrington (Burt Lancaster) carries out a military training operation in preparation for an assassination while he waits for a decision.

programme.title: Nuked

Sick of her husband's violent ways, Vicki seduces Jeff (Glenn Ford), another worker at the railroad, hoping that she can convince him to murder her husband.

With the help of beautiful smuggler Tiffany Case (Jill St. John), Bond sets out to stop the madman - as the fate of the world hangs in the balance!

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
programme.desc: The future of civilization rests in the fate of the One Ring, which has been lost for centuries. Powerful forces are unrelenting in their search for it. But fate has placed it in the hands of a young Hobbit named Frodo Baggins (Elijah Wood), who inherits the Ring and steps into legend. A daunting task lies ahead for Frodo when he becomes the Ringbearer - to destroy the One Ring in the fires of Mount Doom where it was forged.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: The Mummy is a rousing, suspenseful and horrifying epic about an expedition of treasure-seeking explorers in the Sahara Desert in 1925. Stumbling upon an ancient tomb, the hunters unwittingly set loose a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror, which is embodied in the vengeful reincarnation of an Egyptian priest who had been sentenced to an eternity as one of the living dead.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash helps Mags with a favor and navigates a challenge with Karim.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Karen and Davis discover a mannequin dumped in the woods and try to solve the crime; at Corner Gas, Brent surprises Wanda with a scanner; in The Ruby, Lacey, Oscar, Hank, and Emma get drawn into an unusual bet about hand sanitizer.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Emma sees high art in Hank's hedge-trimming and sells his services around town; prompted by Oscar, Brent tries to collect on the IOUs piling up at Corner Gas, resorting to unorthodox means; Davis and Karen set up the cop shop in The Ruby.

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green track a gigolo and con artist who is suspected of murder, but they run into problems when McCoy and Carmichael interview a victim's family.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: When a 15th-century prince denounces God after the loss of his wife he inherits an eternal curse. He becomes Dracula. Condemned to wander the centuries, he defies fate and death, guided by a single hope, to be reunited with his lost love.

programme.title: Merrily We Roll Along
programme.desc: A stage production of Stephen Sondheim's Tony Award-winning musical "Merrily We Roll Along," charting the turbulent relationship between a composer, a writer and a playwright.

programme.title: Thirteen Lives
programme.desc: Rescue workers try to save 12 boys and their soccer coach from a flooded, impenetrable cave system in Thailand.

programme.title: Taking on Taylor Swift
programme.desc: After a lengthy legal battle against pop star Taylor Swift, plaintiff Sean Hall speaks with CNN on how decades of cultural appropriation have shaped the music industry and gives insight on the case that Taylor Swift just couldn't shake off.

programme.title: Crossword Mysteries: Terminal Descent
programme.desc: When Tess prepares for a crossword challenge against a supercomputer, the engineer behind it gets murdered, spurring her and Logan to seek answers before they become the next victims.

programme.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programme.desc: When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.

programme.title: A Sprinkle of Deceit: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: Hannah and Chad flirt with their own paths to solve the same murder while working to clear a colleague who is implicated in the crime. Meanwhile, Delores gets her big break.

programme.title: Shifting Gears
programme.desc: Motor City mechanic Jess reluctantly agrees to participate in a car restoration show and is shocked to learn that her ex-boyfriend, Luke, is her main competitor.

programme.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: To the Moon and Back
programme.desc: The Postables embark on a road trip to track down a rock star and the recipient of a lost letter.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: After an epic battle, a great city lies in ruins, but the Earth itself is saved. As humanity begins to pick up the pieces, a shadowy group emerges to try to take control of history. Meanwhile, an ancient and powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth. A new group of humans, led by Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg), helps Optimus Prime (Peter Cullen) and the Autobots rise up to meet their most fearsome challenge yet: a worldwide war of good versus evil.

programme.title: Marcel the Shell With Shoes On
programme.desc: Marcel, a 1-inch-tall shell, lives with his grandmother, Connie, the only residents of their town after their neighbors' sudden, mysterious disappearance. When discovered by a guest amongst the clutter of his Airbnb, the short film he posts online brings Marcel millions of passionate fans and a new hope of reuniting with his long-lost family.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: The York Memorial team deals with the life changing-surgery of one of their own.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: When Wullerton's weekly paper goes under, the gang worries the Dog River Howler will too; Wanda and Emma set out to recruit new advertisers, while Brent helps Oscar start an online version that raises eyebrows; Karen befriends a crow.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Ike's barn burns down and Lacey wants to help; Lacey organizes a bachelor auction to raise money, attracting a mystery woman who bids high for Brent; the more time the two spend together, the more curious the town gets about the woman's identity.

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: When a teenager is found murdered, Detectives Briscoe and Green suspect a school bully who displays an avid interest in martial-arts weapons.

programme.title: The Traitors: Australia
programme.desc: A group of 24 contestants move into a grand heritage hotel to work as a team and compete in a series of challenges for up to $250,000.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
programme.desc: RuPaul makes a trip across the pond in search of the drag queen with the most charisma, nerve and talent in the United Kingdom, giving the contestants a series of challenges week by week.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: Ronnie is praised by his church community, while others won't let him forget his mistakes; Emmett and Dom prepare for their grand opening; Kevin tries to balance obligations.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: Ronnie finds absolution; Emmett and Tiff take a step toward their future; Trig plays his final card against Douda; life events mature Kevin, Jake and Papa.

programme.title: It: Chapter Two
programme.desc: Defeated by members of the Losers' Club, the evil clown Pennywise returns 27 years later to terrorize the town of Derry, Maine, once again. Now adults, the childhood friends have long since gone their separate ways. But when people start disappearing, Mike Hanlon calls the others home for one final stand. Damaged by scars from the past, the united Losers must conquer their deepest fears to destroy the shape-shifting Pennywise - now more powerful than ever.

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: One year after her sister disappeared, Clover and her friends head to the remote valley where she vanished to search for answers. Exploring an abandoned visitor center, they soon encounter a masked killer who murders them one by one. However, when they mysteriously wake up at the beginning of the same night, they're forced to relive the terror over and over again.

programme.title: Selena + Chef
programme.desc: Known for elevating American dishes with Indian flavors, Aarti Sequeira whips up a tandoori butter turkey breast and colorful side dishes that might just revolutionize Selena's favorite holiday; they are joined by friends to celebrate the holiday.

programme.title: Undercover Grandpa
programme.desc: A shy young man turns to his grandfather and his grandfather's old war buddies to help him rescue the woman of his dreams from kidnappers.

programme.title: Christmas With the Foxes
programme.desc: Rebecca Fox attends her family's annual Christmas party to find her dad is seeing a new woman, not even a year after her mother's death. In her comical efforts to derail the romance, she finds her own love affair.

programme.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: A Fatal Engagement
programme.desc: When Dahlia's boyfriend is found dead, advice columnist Nelly joins Detective Hogan to help find the killer. However, as suspicions creep in, Dahlia becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
programme.desc: Nelly and Michael set out to solve the murder of a guest who was at a lavish dinner.

programme.title: Show of Shows
programme.desc: The Warner Bros. revue, with master of ceremonies (Frank Fay), begins with 192 dancing girls on a huge staircase.

programme.title: The Truth About Youth
programme.desc: A naive young man becomes enamored of a cabaret singer who has sampled liberally from amongst the male population.

programme.title: The Naughty Flirt
programme.desc: A spoiled heiress leaves her boyfriend only to become involved with a man who secretly desires her money.

programme.title: Consolation Marriage
programme.desc: A sportswriter (Pat O'Brien) jilted by his globe-trotting girlfriend (Myrna Loy) marries a woman (Irene Dunne) jilted by her boyfriend.

programme.title: Rebound
programme.desc: A woman (Ina Claire) tries to make her husband (Robert Ames) forget his old flame (Myrna Loy), who is back.

programme.title: Libeled Lady
programme.desc: An editor's fiancée and a lawyer help him trick an heiress suing his paper.

programme.title: I Love You Again
programme.desc: A businessman (William Powell) snaps out of 9-year amnesia, reverts to con man and falls in love with his wife (Myrna Loy).

programme.title: Love Crazy
programme.desc: An old flame (Gail Patrick) and a mother-in-law make a couple's (William Powell, Myrna Loy) fourth anniversary wacky.

programme.title: Double Wedding
programme.desc: A dress designer (Myrna Loy) falls for a lazy artist (William Powell) after deeming him unworthy of her sister (Florence Rice).

programme.title: Evelyn Prentice
programme.desc: A trial lawyer (William Powell) unwittingly defends another woman for a crime of passion committed by his wife (Myrna Loy).

programme.title: The Great Ziegfeld
programme.desc: The life and times of Broadway showman Florenz Ziegfeld and his two wives.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: Shakespeare's Puck (Mickey Rooney) and forest fairies prompt a triple mortal wedding, with entertainment by Bottom (James Cagney).

programme.title: Hitler's Madman
programme.desc: The Nazi Heinrich Himmler condemns the Czech village Lidice after partisans kill the Nazi Reinhard Heydrich (John Carradine).

programme.title: Escape From East Berlin
programme.desc: An East German (Don Murray) tunnels under the Berlin Wall and leads his girlfriend (Christine Kaufmann) and 26 others to freedom.

programme.title: Friendly Persuasion
programme.desc: Indiana Quakers (Gary Cooper, Dorothy McGuire) disagree over their son's (Anthony Perkins) desire to join the Civil War.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: On the way to see his sweetheart (Sylvia Sidney) a man (Spencer Tracy) is wrongly jailed and besieged by a lynch mob.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: An unknown host (Barry Fitzgerald) brings 10 sinners to an island, for punishment one by one.

programme.title: Murder, She Said
programme.desc: Agatha Christie's sleuth Miss Marple (Margaret Rutherford) gets a job at an estate where she thinks there's a corpse.

programme.title: The Kennel Murder Case
programme.desc: Detective Philo Vance sifts through clues and comes up with seven possible suspects in the murder of a sportsman.

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock directs a thriller about a woman who thinks that her husband is plotting to murder her.

programme.title: The Case of the Curious Bride
programme.desc: San Francisco lawyer and gourmet chef Perry Mason (Warren William) solves a murder at a cocktail party.

programme.title: The Case of the Howling Dog
programme.desc: Lawyer Perry Mason (Warren William) shows the jury the truth about three murders stemming from a marital mix-up.

programme.title: MGM Parade Show
programme.desc: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

programme.title: River's End
programme.desc: A fugitive (Charles Bickford) assumes the identity and love life of a look-alike Mountie dead in a blizzard.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: Court followers foil a plot by having a British look-alike (Ronald Colman) pose as the king of Ruritania.

programme.title: The Scarlet Pimpernel
programme.desc: London dandy Sir Percy (Leslie Howard) dons disguises to save French nobles from the Reign of Terror guillotine.

programme.title: The Glass Slipper
programme.desc: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

programme.title: When in Rome
programme.desc: A priest (Van Johnson) on a pilgrimage tours Roman cathedrals with an escaped convict (Paul Douglas) posing as a priest.

programme.title: You Can't Fool Your Wife
programme.desc: An outcast husband (James Ellison) flirts with another woman who turns out to be his wife (Lucille Ball).

programme.title: Quality Street
programme.desc: A British spinster (Katharine Hepburn) poses as her niece to woo an ex-suitor (Franchot Tone) back from the Napoleonic wars.

programme.title: The Guardsman
programme.desc: An Austrian actor suspicious of his wife's loyalty decides to test her by posing as a charming military officer.

programme.title: Hero at Large
programme.desc: An actor (John Ritter) costumed as Captain Avenger foils a grocery-store robbery and becomes a sensation.

programme.title: Matinee
programme.desc: A producer (John Goodman) sells his new monster movie with gimmicks in Key West, Fla., during the 1962 Cuban missile crisis.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.

programme.title: The Howling
programme.desc: A shaken TV newswoman (Dee Wallace) finds a doctor's (Patrick Macnee) retreat crawling with werewolves.

programme.title: Eyes of a Stranger
programme.desc: A TV newswoman (Lauren Tewes) catches a pervert (John DiSanti) watching her sister (Jennifer Jason Leigh) who cannot see, hear or speak.

programme.title: The First Deadly Sin
programme.desc: A New York police detective with a bedridden wife hunts a killer who uses a mountaineer's ice ax.

programme.title: Jupiter's Darling
programme.desc: Roman general Fabius sends his swimming bride (Esther Williams) to stall an invasion by Hannibal (Howard Keel) and his elephants.

programme.title: The Last Days of Pompeii
programme.desc: A blacksmith (Preston Foster) becomes a gladiator and Pontius Pilate's (Basil Rathbone) partner, then sees Vesuvius erupt and finds Christ.

programme.title: Caesar and Cleopatra
programme.desc: The aging Caesar finds himself intrigued by the young Egyptian queen. Adapted by George Bernard Shaw from his own play.

programme.title: Julius Caesar
programme.desc: Shakespeare's Brutus (James Mason), Cassius (John Gielgud) and others plot the Roman ruler's death, but Mark Antony (Marlon Brando) avenges it.

programme.title: Barabbas
programme.desc: A thief is spared from crucifixion and tries to comprehend the man sent to die in his place.

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: A gladiator slave (Kirk Douglas) leads a revolt in decadent Rome and attempts to lead his followers to freedom.

programme.title: They Shoot Horses, Don't They?
programme.desc: Desperate people (Jane Fonda, Michael Sarrazin, Susannah York) enter a grueling dance marathon in Depression-era Chicago.

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: A chic writer (Tallulah Bankhead), a stoker (William Bendix) and others drift with the U-boat captain (Walter Slezak) who has sunk their ship.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: Formless red slime lands in Pennsylvania and engulfs people; teens (Steven McQueen, Aneta Corseaut) try to warn scoffing adults.

programme.title: Fiend Without a Face
programme.desc: A scientist's (Marshall Thompson) atomic-powered thoughts materialize as deadly flying brains with trailing spinal cords.

programme.title: The Thing From Another World
programme.desc: Arctic soldiers and scientists find an alien aircraft containing a frozen creature (James Arness) that wakes and feeds on human blood.

programme.desc: S10 E5 Don McLean: American Pie The story of Don McLean's second album 'American Pie'. Crowned by its titular overture and the song 'Vincent', McLean's equally moving tribute to Van Gogh, 'American Pie' is a classic of the folk-rock genre, earning its place alongside Carole King's 'Tapestry', Joni Mitchell's 'Blue' and Neil Young's 'After The Gold Rush' as one of the landmark singer-songwriter LPs of 1971, a year recently celebrated in a book by award-winning journalist David Hepworth as 'rock's golden year'.

programme.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries

programme.title: theZoomer

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: Based on novels by Maureen Jennings, "Murdoch Mysteries" follows young detective William Murdoch. In a series of stories taking place in Toronto during the 1890s and early 1900s, several challenging murder cases arise. Murdoch uses up-and-coming forensics techniques and an unconventional approach, which often elicit skepticism from his fellow officers and his boss. Coroner Julia Ogden becomes Murdoch's number one ally, and they make a top-notch team, but he must struggle against tradition and prejudice to solve some of the city's most-gruesome murders.

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Mystery writer and amateur detective Jessica Fletcher - a down-to-earth, middle-aged widow - ferrets out the criminals in idyllic Cabot Cove, Maine, which apparently is the murder capital of the United States for the show's 12-season run. Though while traveling, she uncovers a fair number of killers as well.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Fox hunting, taxidermy and Oscar Wilde are part of the backdrop as Barnaby and Troy investigate a series of murders, beginning with that of a tramp in the woods.

programme.title: The Forgotten Expulsion: Jews From Arab Lands
programme.desc: Highlighting that in 1947-1948, it was not only 500,000 Palestinians who were displaced during the Israel war of independence but 850,000 Jews were also expelled from their ancient homes in Arab countries by Islamic regimes.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: Based on novels by Maureen Jennings, "Murdoch Mysteries" follows young detective William Murdoch. In a series of stories taking place in Toronto during the 1890s and early 1900s, several challenging murder cases arise. Murdoch uses up-and-coming forensics techniques and an unconventional approach, which often elicit skepticism from his fellow officers and his boss. Coroner Julia Ogden becomes Murdoch's number one ally, and they make a top-notch team, but he must struggle against tradition and prejudice to solve some of the city's most-gruesome murders.

programme.title: Chariots of Fire
programme.desc: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided United Kingdom of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics. Eric Liddell (Ian Charleson), a devout Christian born to Scottish missionaries in China, sees running as part of his worship of God's glory and refuses to train or compete on the Sabbath. Harold Abrahams (Ben Cross) overcomes anti-Semitism and class bias, but neglects his beloved sweetheart Sybil (Alice Krige) in his single-minded quest.

programme.title: Tribal Trails
programme.desc: A First Nations show with a message of hope.

programme.title: Tomorrow's World
programme.desc: Tomorrow's World makes sense of your world through the pages of the Bible. Sponsored by the Living Church of God, Tomorrow's World proclaims the good news of the coming Kingdom of God and warns of the troubled times ahead.

programme.title: 700 Club Canada

programme.title: Garnizoana
programme.desc: Robert, un fost agent CIA și fiul său înstrăinat sunt captivi într-un buncăr high-tech. Vor fi zidurile groase și apărările suficient de puternice împotriva forțelor lui Balzary, un dusman de temut de-ai lui Robert?

programme.title: Pe muchia dreptății
programme.desc: În Los Angeles, Agentul Maxwell descoperă o operațiune de contrabandă de cocaină internațională condusă de Vincent Camastra. Când Beverly Royce merge sub acoperire și ia legătura cu dealerii de droguri, se afundă mai adânc decât sperase.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volumul 1
programme.desc: Bill şi banda sa măcelăresc toţi invitaţii unei nunţi. Deşi lumea o consideră moartă, Mireasa îşi revine din comă după patru ani şi porneşte răzbunarea: îi omoară unul câte unul pe asasini, lăsându-l ultimul pe Bill.

programme.title: Lupta uitată
programme.desc: În timpul bătăliei de la Schelde din al Doilea Război Mondial, un pilot de planor, un soldat nazist și o membră a Rezistenței își împletesc, în mod tragic, destinele.

programme.title: Cowboy din tata-n fiu
programme.desc: Charlie Bankston a fost un fermier si un cowboy care si-a trait viata din plin, lasand o mostenire extraordinara celor care l-au cunoscut. Insa o data cu disparitia sa, viitorul fermei in care si-a pus tot sufletul, Dry Creek, devine nesigur.

programme.title: Vremuri întunecate
programme.desc: Cinci tineri nord-americani sosesc în capitala Rusiei pentru a petrece o vacanţă de vis într-o metropolă despre care nu cunosc prea multe amănunte, dar se trezesc blocaţi într-un oraş invadat de o specie extraterestră malefică.

programme.title: Răpirea lui Sinatra
programme.desc: In 1963, trei prieteni din sudul Californiei au pus la cale lovitura imposibila: rapirea lui Frank Sinatra jr. Aceasta e relatarea incredibilei tentative care a facut dintr-un tanar cantaret unul din cei mai faimosi ostatici din istorie.

programme.title: Vizitatorii
programme.desc: In anul 1122, prin actiunea concertata a unei vrajitoare sinistre si a unui magician glumet, razboinicul de vita veche Godefroy de Montmirail si scutierul sau Jacquouille la Fripouille sunt trimisi in viitor, intr-o epoca nebuna, in zilele noastre.

programme.title: Căzut din cer
programme.desc: Ajunsă in Savannah după ce prietenul ei moare într-un accident misterios, Lucinda, o adolescentă de 17 ani, se îndrăgostește de Daniel, dar descoperă un adevăr incredibil de tulburător: el este un înger căzut, iar iubirea lor este veche de secole...

programme.title: Jumper: Oriunde, oricând
programme.desc: Davey, un adolescent care tocmai a renuntat la parintii sai abuzivi, descopera ca se poate teleporta cu puterea gandului. Davey habar n-are cum de este in stare sa se teleporteze, dar afla in curand ca sufera de-o anomalie genetica.

programme.title: Taxi 2 - Operațiunea Ninja
programme.desc: Ambasadorul Japoniei face o vizita oficiala in Marsilia pentru a vedea cu ochii lui strategia politiei locale in lupta cu bandele organizate. Din pacate, insa, pe timpul vizitei, el este rapit de un grup de banditi care lucrau pentru mafia japoneza.

programme.title: Detectiv fără voie
programme.desc: Hoțul de bijuterii Miles Logan vrea să recupereze un diamant pe care-l furase printr-o acțiune spectaculoasă și apoi să dispară pentru o vreme. El pretinde ca ar fi politist si se alege cu reputația de cel mai curajos, dur și nostim ofițer din L.A..

programme.title: Impact fatal 2
programme.desc: Kit (Wu Jing) este un ofiţer de poliţie din Hong Kong care lucrează sub acoperire pentru a-l prinde pe dl Hung, capul unei organizaţii criminale. Atunci când operaţiunea eşuează şi poliţiştii sub acoperire sunt trădaţi, Kit dispare fără urmă.

programme.title: Râuri de purpură 2: Îngerii apocalipsei
programme.desc: Continuare a filmului de succes Râuri de purpură, regizat de Mathieu Kassovitz. În Lorena, lângă graniţa cu Germania, Inspectorul-Sef Pierre\nNiemans (Jean Reno) anchetează moartea unui om care a fost crucificat,\nîntr-un ritual.

programme.title: Diablo
programme.desc: Kris Chaney, fost deținut recent eliberat, pornește într-o misiune periculoasă: o răpește pe Elisa, fiica unui gangster puternic, atrăgând astfel furia unui criminal psihopat dornic de răzbunare.

programme.title: Henric al VIII-lea
programme.desc: Tiran si afemeiat, Henry VIII a fost regele care a schimbat Anglia pentru totdeauna. De peste 450 de ani, cati au trecut de la moartea sa, viata si mostenirea lui Henry VIII continua sa fascineze o lume intreaga.

programme.title: Henric al VIII-lea
programme.desc: Tiran si afemeiat, Henry VIII a fost regele care a schimbat Anglia pentru totdeauna. De peste 450 de ani, cati au trecut de la moartea sa, viata si mostenirea lui Henry VIII continua sa fascineze o lume intreaga.

programme.title: Iubesc pe cine nu trebuie
programme.desc: Lui Duke îi place de Olivia căreia îi place de Sebastian, care de fapt este Viola al cărei frate e iubitul lui Monique, așa că o urăște pe Olivia care e prietena lui Duke ca să-l facă gelos pe Sebastian, care de fapt e Viola...

programme.title: Servicii complete pentru Sara
programme.desc: Joe Tyler nu are chiar cel mai grozav job din lume, dar nu se dã în lãturi de la nimic ca sã o îndeplineascã. Treaba lui este sã facã rost de documente legale în diferite procese, iar printre clientii sãi se numãrã si oameni obisnuiti, si milionari.

programme.title: Piedone comisarul fără armă
programme.desc: Inspectorul Rizzo face dreptate fara sa poarte arma la el, ajutat de eternul inspector Caputo. Pumnii lui sunt arme letale pentru cei care incalca legea.

programme.title: Legionarul
programme.desc: Doi oameni sunt ucisi iar vina este aruncata asupra lui Alain Lefevre. Cu o clipa inainte ca politia si acolitii mafiotului sa-l prinda, Lefevre evadeaza intr-o identitate absolut noua - aceea de soldat, mercenar in Legiunea Straina Franceza.

programme.title: Unde dai și unde crapă
programme.desc: Hoţul de diamante şi curierul Franky "Four Fingers" (Franky „Patru degete"), interpretat de Benicio Del Toro, poposeşte la Londra, în drumul său spre New York, unde urma să-i livreze un diamant uriaş sefului său.

programme.title: Cod de onoare
programme.desc: Fostul colonel al fortelor speciale, Robert Sikes, se întoarce acasa din Orientul Mijlociu, pentru a deveni un justițiar, al carui unic scop este acela de a elimina criminalitatea în orasul sau, care s-a înrăutatit dramatic.

programme.title: O legendă se naşte
programme.desc: Un orfan al carui tata a fost ucis vrea sa restabileasca linistea si pacea in orasul sau.

programme.title: O anchetă complicată
programme.desc: Rosario, anii ’80. Un bărbat dispare în timpul dictaturii militare. Doi tineri trebuie să facă tot posibilul pentru a rezolva cazul, asta deși polițiștii corupți le pun viața în pericol.

programme.title: Vizitatorii
programme.desc: In anul 1122, prin actiunea concertata a unei vrajitoare sinistre si a unui magician glumet, razboinicul de vita veche Godefroy de Montmirail si scutierul sau Jacquouille la Fripouille sunt trimisi in viitor, intr-o epoca nebuna, in zilele noastre.

programme.title: Vremuri întunecate
programme.desc: Cinci tineri nord-americani sosesc în capitala Rusiei pentru a petrece o vacanţă de vis într-o metropolă despre care nu cunosc prea multe amănunte, dar se trezesc blocaţi într-un oraş invadat de o specie extraterestră malefică.

programme.title: Căzut din cer
programme.desc: Ajunsă in Savannah după ce prietenul ei moare într-un accident misterios, Lucinda, o adolescentă de 17 ani, se îndrăgostește de Daniel, dar descoperă un adevăr incredibil de tulburător: el este un înger căzut, iar iubirea lor este veche de secole...

programme.title: Eroul
programme.desc: In China antica impartita in 7 regate, luptatori din 6 regate vor sa il asasineze pe cel mai puternic conducator: Qin. Cand un dregator lipsit de importanta infrange 3 mari dusmani ai lui Qin, este chemat la palat sa-si spuna povestea.

programme.title: În bătaia puștii
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan este un agent al serviciilor secrete, dur și inflexibil, obsedat de o greșeală din trecutul său. Nu poate uita data de 22 noiembrie 1963, când nu l-a putut apăra pe președintele John F. Kennedy, în timpul fatalei vizite din Dallas.

programme.title: Călugărul coboară de pe munte
programme.desc: Bazat pe romanul lui Xu Haofeng "Un călugăr vine pe munte", filmul relatează povestea unui tânăr cleric taoist numit He Anxia, care in anii 1930 este expulzat din mănăstire și ajunge într-un oraș chinezesc.

programme.title: Terminatorul 3: Supremația roboților
programme.desc: John are acum 18 ani, iar o femeie Terminator, Terminatrix, este trimisă de către roboţi pe urmele sale pentru a-l asasina. Alt Terminator se va întoarce în trecut pentru a-l proteja pe John: T-800 se întoarce şi va lupta în războiul contra roboţilor.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volumul 2
programme.desc: Mireasa îşi continuă răzbunarea cu următorii de pe listă, lăsându-l la final pe Bill. Dar şi Bill îi pregăteşte o surpriză de proporţii. Capitolul final al celui mai îndrăzneţ proiect al lui Quentin Tarantino!

programme.title: Revolta robotilor
programme.desc: Un producător american de arme își testează cei 4 roboți ucigași pe producătorii de heroină din Triunghiul de Aur, în Asia de Sud-Est. Lucrurile scapa de sub control.

programme.title: Deep Star 6
programme.desc: O echipă de membri ai marinei staționate la o bază temporară pe fundul oceanului și însărcinate cu instalarea rachetelor nucleare descoperă o imensă cavernă subacvatică ce adăpostește o creatură preistorică uriașă.

programme.title: Numb Chucks
programme.desc: When Fungus eats an acorn, Buford convinces him that a giant tree will soon grow out of his nose, leaving him stranded forever. Then, Fungus gets a makeover and becomes handsome.

programme.title: Numb Chucks
programme.desc: A slimy businessman opens up a popular new business in the Pinheads parking lot. Then, Buford finds out Quills can perform mouth-to-mouth resuscitation.

programme.title: Numb Chucks

programme.title: Numb Chucks

programme.title: Numb Chucks
programme.desc: The town has a bug infestation problem but when the unaware Chucks eat all the bug repellent, how will the town be saved? Then, the Chucks take a vacation at Grandma Butternut's BandB.

programme.desc: It's time for the Ding-A-Ling Springs annual pie bake-off, so the Chucks help Granny guard her prized entry from her greatest rival. Then, Dilweed and Fungus run afoul of a pair of wrestlers.

programme.title: Numb Chucks

programme.title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: This updated adaptation of the classic fairytale tells the story of Danielle, a vibrant young woman who is forced into servitude after the death of her father. Danielle's stepmother Rodmilla is a heartless woman who forces Danielle to do the cooking and cleaning, while she tries to marry off her own two daughters. But Danielle's life takes a wonderful turn when she meets the charming Prince Henry.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: After learning that his father is dying, karate master Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita) returns home to Okinawa, bringing his protégé, Daniel, with him. In Japan, Miyagi is surprised to discover that his old sweetheart, Yukie, has remained single. Meanwhile, Daniel is attracted to Yukie's niece, Kumiko. But romance must be put on hold while Daniel and Miyagi deal with local bullies and long-harbored grudges.

programme.title: Dumb & Dumber
programme.desc: Imbecilic best friends Lloyd Christmas (Jim Carrey) and Harry Dunne (Jeff Daniels) stumble across a suitcase full of money left behind in Harry's car by Mary Swanson (Lauren Holly), who was on her way to the airport. The pair decide to go to Aspen, Colo., to return the money, unaware that it is connected to a kidnapping. As Harry and Lloyd - who has fallen in love with Mary - are pursued across the country by hired killers and police, they find both their friendship and their brains tested.

programme.title: Strange Brew
programme.desc: In their quest for free beer, bumbling Canadian brothers Bob (Rick Moranis) and Doug McKenzie (Dave Thomas) wind up working at the Elsinore Brewery. The hapless lads uncover a sinister mind-control plot spearheaded by Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and must stop the scheme, which also involves Uncle Claude (Paul Dooley), a member of the Elsinore family. As Bob and Doug try to prevent Smith from taking over the world, they also manage to drink plenty of their favorite sudsy beverage.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Thirty-two-year-old Sonny Koufax (Adam Sandler) has spent his whole life avoiding responsibility. But when his girlfriend dumps him for an older man, he's got to find a way to prove he's ready to grow up. In a desperate last-ditch effort, Sonny adopts 5-year-old Julian (Dylan Sprouse), (Cole Sprouse) to impress her. She's not impressed ... and he can't return the kid. Uh-oh for Sonny!

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. For Milo, it means meeting with his first love to see if their romance can reignite. Eventually, they learn that living truthfully and accepting each other is the only way to move forward.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: Catherine aims to unite France under King Charles IX, pushing her agenda of a secular state; the Bourbons present an ambitious trade deal with Protestant England; as tensions rise on the Privy Council, the Guise's plan to reignite religious conflict.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: With peace lying on a knife's edge, Catherine attempts to calm tensions by allowing the Bourbons to pursue the trade deal with England, and she halts the investigation into the Duke of Guise's arson involvement.

programme.title: The Rose Family
programme.desc: Filmmaker Félix Rose examines the kidnapping and murder of Canadian politician Pierre Laporte in 1970.

programme.title: Owning Mahowny
programme.desc: Toronto bank employee Dan Mahowny (Philip Seymour Hoffman) seems like an honest man to his coworkers and loving girlfriend, Belinda (Minnie Driver). None of them realize that he is actually a compulsive gambler who steals from the bank's accounts to pay off his bookie, Frank (Maury Chaykin), and fund regular trips to casinos. Sleazy casino boss Victor (John Hurt) encourages Dan to amass more and more debt, until the missing money becomes hard to hide, and Dan's life spirals out of control.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Kate warns Magnus about some Abnormals plotting a terrorist attack; she and Addison learn that Bigfoot may be a part of the terrorist cell.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Seeking to outrace the SCIU, Magnus and Will are captured, injured and trapped in a Bolivian cave; alone, the two friends struggle to survive as they confront who they are and who they've become.

programme.title: One Day in the Life of Noah Piugattuk
programme.desc: A government agent tries to get an Inuit man and his children to move to settlement housing.

programme.title: Milton's Secret
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Milton Adams (William Ainscough) feels his world is in crisis. With his parents stressing about their careers and finances, and the neighborhood bully tormenting him, he is constantly anxious. When Milton's optimistic grandfather (Donald Sutherland) comes to visit, he learns the secret to finding true happiness from a man who has seen the world and who has committed to living life in the present.

programme.title: Eve & the Fire Horse
programme.desc: Eve Eng (Phoebe Jojo Kut) is the 9-year-old daughter of Buddhist Chinese immigrants living in Vancouver, British Columbia. Although Eve has been raised with her family's traditional Chinese beliefs, she begins to doubt that their religion can see her family through a string of misfortunes. Much to the dismay of their traditionally-minded family members, Eve and her equally independent sister, Karena (Hollie Lo), take a new and unusual path: they discover Catholicism.

programme.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
programme.desc: When Kermit the Frog and friends start a stage act, they decide to take the show from their college town to Broadway. However, once The Muppets wind up in New York City, they have difficulty finding financial support for the production, instead running into cheats like Murray Plotsky. Unable to stage the show, the group splits up, and they all take different jobs around the country. Just as Kermit thinks he has finally found a backer, an accident gives him amnesia.

programme.title: Muppets From Space
programme.desc: With enormous enthusiasm and unsinkable optimism, daredevil Gonzo steps into his first starring role in "Muppets From Space," a hilarious extraterrestrial adventure about the search for Gonzo's past. On a quest with buddy Rizzo to find his real family, Gonzo discovers that his long-lost relatives are actually aliens from a distant planet.

programme.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
programme.desc: Mr. Peabody (Ty Burrell), the most accomplished canine in the world, and his boy, Sherman (Max Charles), use a time machine called the Wabac to embark on outrageous adventures. However, when Sherman takes the Wabac without permission to impress his friend Penny (Ariel Winter), he accidentally rips a hole in the universe and causes havoc with world history. It's up to Mr. Peabody to mount a rescue and prevent the past, present and future from being permanently altered.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Baby (Jennifer Grey) is one listless summer away from the Peace Corps. Hoping to enjoy her youth while it lasts, she's disappointed when her summer plans deposit her at a sleepy resort in the Catskills with her parents. Her luck turns around, however, when the resort's dance instructor, Johnny (Patrick Swayze), enlists Baby as his new partner, and the two fall in love. Baby's father forbids her from seeing Johnny, but she's determined to help him perform the last big dance of the summer.

programme.title: Country Strong
programme.desc: While recuperating at a rehab facility, country-music superstar Kelly Canter (Gwyneth Paltrow) takes a romantic interest in Beau Hutton (Garrett Hedlund), a talented musician who works there. Kelly includes Beau in her plans as she prepares for a comeback tour orchestrated by her manager husband, James (Tim McGraw), who also has a protege he is grooming for stardom. As the quartet goes on the road, personal demons and romantic entanglements threaten to derail them all.

programme.title: Lady Bird
programme.desc: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school.

programme.title: Frances Ha
programme.desc: Frances (Greta Gerwig) goes from apartment to apartment in Brooklyn as she looks for a job and a stable partner.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: News of Edith's miracle spreads throughout Europe; the Bourbon's leverage an opportunity for England to exploit France; Catherine must return urgently to France when Anjou's temper causes damage.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: Charles is ready to make his own rules, rejecting his mother's influence; with a rebellion on the rise, a mysterious plan is set, but when loyalty can be so easily swayed...miracles can happen.

programme.title: Hyena Road
programme.desc: During the war in Afghanistan, an intelligence officer (Paul Gross) enlists a sniper (Rossif Sutherland) to track down a legendary freedom fighter.

programme.title: The Sweet Hereafter
programme.desc: A small mountain community in Canada is devastated when a school bus accident leaves more than a dozen of its children dead. A big-city lawyer (Ian Holm) arrives to help the survivors' and victims' families prepare a class-action suit, but his efforts only seem to push the townspeople further apart. At the same time, one teenage survivor of the accident (Sarah Polley) has to reckon with the loss of innocence brought about by a different kind of damage.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: The new Abnormal Homeland is in danger, forcing Helen Magnus into a corner; she has a plan that no one would suspect.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: The new Abnormal Homeland is in danger, forcing Helen Magnus into a corner; she has a plan that no one would suspect.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Spawned from a lab experiment gone awry, teenage terrapins Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael live in the sewers beneath New York. Although their rodent sensei, Splinter, advises against showing themselves above ground, the justice-loving, pizza-eating brothers can't stand idly by while evil Shredder and his minions terrorize the city. With help from intrepid reporter April O'Neil (Megan Fox) and her cameraman (Will Arnett), the Turtles set out to save New York.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The turtles face a new challenge when Shredder escapes from custody and joins forces with Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist who plans to use a serum to take over the world. Along for the ride are Bebop and Rocksteady, two dimwitted henchmen who provide plenty of muscle. Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. As the pizza-loving heroes prepare for battle, the notorious Krang also emerges to pose an even greater threat.

programme.title: The Games Maker
programme.desc: Ivan's love of board games transports him into the competitive world of game invention.

programme.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
programme.desc: After burning though eight lives, Puss in Boots sets out on an epic journey to find the mythical Last Wish and restore all nine.

programme.title: Field of Dreams
programme.desc: When Iowa farmer Ray hears a mysterious voice one night in his cornfield saying "If you build it, he will come," he feels the need to act. Despite taunts of lunacy, Ray builds a baseball diamond on his land, supported by his wife, Annie. Afterward, the ghosts of great players start emerging from the crops to play ball, led by "Shoeless" Joe Jackson. But, as Ray learns, this field of dreams is about much more than bringing former baseball greats out to play.

programme.title: The Great Gatsby
programme.desc: Midwest native Nick Carraway (Tobey Maguire) arrives in 1922 New York in search of the American dream. Nick, a would-be writer, moves in next-door to millionaire Jay Gatsby (Leonardo DiCaprio) and across the bay from his cousin Daisy (Carey Mulligan) and her philandering husband, Tom (Joel Edgerton). Thus, Nick becomes drawn into the captivating world of the wealthy and - as he bears witness to their illusions and deceits - pens a tale of impossible love, dreams, and tragedy.

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle.

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: Catherine relinquishes her seat on the Privy Council, but not before securing a place for Anjou; a religious war is on the horizon as Queen Elizabeth lands in the Netherlands; France's saving grace may be a marriage.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: Queen Elizabeth's arrival sparks manipulation and intrigue within the Valois Court; a dramatic fencing match for the Queen's affections ends in a shocking revelation, leaving the Court in turmoil.

programme.title: Gabrielle
programme.desc: A young woman who has Williams syndrome possesses amazing musical talents but struggles continually to gain her independence.

programme.title: French Exit
programme.desc: A widowed New York socialite and her aimless son move to Paris after she spends the last of her husband's inheritance.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Helen Magnus recruits a forensic psychiatrist to join her in a quest to track, study and protect the creatures that secretly populate the world.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Helen Magnus recruits a forensic psychiatrist to join her in a quest to track, study and protect the creatures that secretly populate the world.

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: Meatball, a wise cracking country dog, and Cassie, Hollywood's most pampered pet, meet when their owners get married. The two fight constantly until burglars break into their house, and they must team up to protect their home.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: When the Littles go to an orphanage to adopt a new family member, a charming young mouse named Stuart is chosen. While George is initially unwelcoming to his new brother, the family cat, Snowbell, is even less enthusiastic about having a mouse as his "master" and plots to get rid of him. Against these difficulties, Stuart resolves to face them with as much pluck, love and courage as he can muster. In doing so, he shows his beloved new family that great things can truly come in small packages.

programme.title: Raise Your Voice
programme.desc: After her brother (Jason Ritter) dies in a car accident, Terri (Hilary Duff) wants to leave her small-town life to attend a performing arts school in Los Angeles, but her father (David Keith) forbids her from going. Under the auspices of visiting an aunt, Terri leaves for L.A., but now she has to prepare for the school's talent competition while also keeping her secret from her father. Meanwhile, Terri's singing partner, Jay (Oliver James), is harboring a secret crush.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Ready, set, snow! Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race, only to break down right before the finish line. Convinced that Zac cheated, Frankie demands a rematch and raises the stakes by betting his team's clubhouse. Frankie and the gang build a spectacular new race track and the stage is set for the biggest race of the season.

programme.title: Arab Women Say What?!
programme.desc: A group of Arab women share a love of laughter, food and life. Their conversations offer a glimpse into their unique perspectives and experiences, such as feminism in Arab society.

programme.title: Think Like a Man
programme.desc: For one reason or another, friends Dominic, Jeremy, Michael and Zeke just can't seem to seal the deal with the women in their lives. When their lovely ladies buy a book by comic Steve Harvey and start to apply its advice to their relationships, this band of brothers gets all shook up. Learning that they have been betrayed by one of their own, Dominic and his friends conspire to use the book's teachings to turn the tables.

programme.title: The Mask
programme.desc: When timid bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss (Jim Carrey) discovers a magical mask containing the spirit of the Norse god Loki, his entire life changes. While wearing the mask, Ipkiss becomes a supernatural playboy exuding charm and confidence which allows him to catch the eye of local nightclub singer Tina Carlyle (Cameron Diaz). Unfortunately, under the mask's influence, Ipkiss also robs a bank, which angers junior crime lord Dorian Tyrell (Peter Greene), whose goons get blamed for the heist.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: A trio of elite private investigators armed with the latest in high-tech tools, high-performance vehicles, martial arts techniques and an array of disguises unleashes their state-of-the-art skills on land, sea and air to track down a kidnapped billionaire-to-be and keep his top-secret voice-identification software out of lethal hands. They're beautiful, they're brilliant, and they work for Charlie. In "Charlie's Angels," a sexy, high-octane update of the original '70s action-comedy TV series.

programme.title: Honk for Jesus. Save Your Soul
programme.desc: Proud first lady of a Southern Baptist megachurch, Trinitie Childs carries immense responsibility on her shoulders. After a scandal involving her husband, the church is forced to temporarily close, leaving Trinitie struggling to manage the aftermath. Now, she and her spouse must rebuild their congregation and reconcile their faith by all means necessary to make the biggest comeback that commodified religion has ever seen.

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Brennan Huff (Will Ferrell) and Dale Doback (John C. Reilly) have one thing in common: they are both lazy, unemployed leeches who still live with their parents. When Brennan's mother and Dale's father marry and move in together, it turns the overgrown boys' world upside down. Their insane rivalry and narcissism pull the new family apart, forcing them to work together to reunite their parents.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: Tensions escalate as Edith and her followers wield newfound power while Catherine grapples with political manipulations and betrayals; as Queen Elizabeth's schemes unravel, Catherine must strategize to secure power and navigate a web of deceit.

programme.title: The Serpent Queen
programme.desc: Catherine's actions lead to chaos and bloodshed, leaving a trail of devastation in their wake; Catherine's desperate measures may prevent total war, or they could unleash forces beyond her control.

programme.title: Reel Injun
programme.desc: Excerpts from classic and contemporary portrayals of Native Americans in film are interwoven with interviews with actors and film historians discussing their various stereotypes.

programme.title: Fire
programme.desc: Sita and Radha are two Indian women stuck in loveless marriages. While Sita is trapped in an arranged relationship with her cruel and unfaithful husband, Jatin, Radha is married to his brother, Ashok, a religious zealot who believes in suppressing desire. As the two women recognize their similar situations, they grow closer, and their relationship becomes far more involved than either of them could have anticipated.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus, Ashley and Will release three women from a crypt in Scotland and bring them back to the Sanctuary for refuge.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: After thieves make an escape that baffles police, Dr. Magnus suspects an abnormal's involvement; the robbery reminds Will of an old FBI case he could not solve; but this time he will.

programme.title: Pokémon Detective Pikachu
programme.desc: Ace detective Harry Goodman goes mysteriously missing, prompting his 21-year-old son, Tim, to find out what happened. Aiding in the investigation is Harry's former Pokémon partner, super-sleuth Detective Pikachu. Finding that they are uniquely equipped to work together, as Tim is the only human who can talk with Pikachu, they join forces to unravel the tangled mystery.

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: An anthropologist (Rick Schroder) leads an expedition to an underground world of prehistoric beasts and primitive man.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an island where none should exist. Knowing that he will not be able to dissuade Sean from tracking the signal to its source, Hank, Sean's new stepfather, joins the teen on a quest to the South Pacific. Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: A teenage hockey player becomes a national sensation.

programme.title: Watermark
programme.desc: This documentary brings together diverse stories from around the globe and explores our relationship with water and how it shapes humanity.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Jamie Graham (Christian Bale), a privileged English boy, is living in Shanghai when the Japanese invade and force all foreigners into prison camps. Jamie is captured with an American sailor named Basie (John Malkovich), who looks out for him while they are in the camp together. Even though he is separated from his parents and in a hostile environment, Jamie maintains his dignity and youthful spirits, providing a beacon of hope for the others held captive with him.

programme.title: Superman Returns
programme.desc: While Lex Luthor plots to destroy him once and for all, the Man of Steel returns after a long absence to a much-changed world. Lois Lane has moved on with her life, and society has learned to survive without him. Superman must find a way to reconnect with her and find his place in a world that may no longer need him.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: Ellen and Grace ride across the Highlands in search of Brian and Dougal's forces.

programme.title: Tip Toe
programme.desc: Leo suspects someone's been inside his house; when Clive brings his son Saul to work in Leo's bar, events soon reach a shocking conclusion.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky (Will Smith), a veteran con artist, takes a novice named Jess (Margot Robbie) under his wing. While Nicky teaches Jess the tricks of the trade, the pair become romantically involved; but, when Jess gets uncomfortably close, Nicky ends their relationship. Three years later, Nicky is in Buenos Aires working a very dangerous scheme when Jess - now an accomplished femme fatale - unexpectedly shows up. Her appearance throws Nicky for a loop at a time when he cannot afford to be off his game.

programme.title: Dear Audrey
programme.desc: A filmmaker cares for his wife as she goes through the final stages of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Mommy
programme.desc: A peculiar neighbor (Suzanne Clément) offers hope to a recent widow (Anne Dorval) who is struggling to raise a teenager (Antoine-Olivier Pilon) who is unpredictable and, sometimes, violent.

programme.title: Snowtime!
programme.desc: Children (Angela Gallupo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball) in a small village learn valuable life lessons when they form two teams for a massive snowball fight.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior: Ninja vs. Ninja
programme.desc: Epic competition series "American Ninja Warrior: Ninja vs. Ninja" pits three-person athletic teams against one another on physically demanding, side-by-side obstacle courses that test endurance and speed. Hosted by comedian Matt Iseman and former NFL player Akbar Gbajabiamila, the show features even more challenging obstacles this season, incorporating speed, human agility, skill, and a whole new strategy of racing. programme.title: Stay
programme.desc: Sam Foster (Ewan McGregor), a psychiatrist, has a new patient, Henry Letham (Ryan Gosling), who claims to be suicidal. In trying to diagnose him, Sam visits Henry's prior therapist (Janeane Garofalo) and also finds Henry's mother -- even though Henry has said that he murdered both of his parents. As reality starts to contradict fact, Sam spirals into an unstable mental state. Then he finds a clue as to how and when Henry may try to kill himself, and races to try to stop him.

programme.title: Night Is Not Eternal
programme.desc: Night Is Not Eternal is a deeply personal exploration of political activism through the eyes of Chinese American filmmaker Nanfu Wang. For over seven years, Nanfu follows Rosa Maria Paya, a young Cuban activist and daughter of five-time Nobel Peace Prize nominee Oswaldo Paya, in her fight for democratic change in Cuba. Driven by her own experiences in China, Nanfu is drawn to Rosa's story and the parallels between their homelands. With intimate access, Nanfu follows Rosa's journey from the streets of Havana to rallies and conferences worldwide, capturing her transformation from a grassroots activist to an international public figure and documenting the challenges faced by activists resisting authoritarian regimes.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Forța Pericol
programme.desc: Eroul Captain Man și inventatorul Schwoz recrutează patru copii pentru a-i pregăti să fie supereroi la Academia pentru dotați din Swellview, unde copiii sunt învățați să-și folosească superputerile și să se lupte contra răului în echipă.

programme.desc: SpongeBob sau Buretele Bob, este un buretel care duce o viata normala dar nelipsita de aventuri. Calamarul, Sandy veverita, Plancton, dl. Krabs, si prietenul lui cel mai bun, Patrick, sunt personajele care i se alatura in aventurile lui zilnice.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.
